descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S18 Existing specs: delete asks once, Cancel keeps, OK removes, and there is no bulk delete

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Delete asks for confirmation once; there is no bulk delete in V1. (TFA-92579 AC 2; UAT TC-24)
  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept. (TFA-92579 AC 2; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given One Hospital patient (Tim's fixture)

When Click the card's remove control and dismiss / accept the first dialog; open Settings

Then One confirmation; Cancel keeps the patient; OK removes it from the list and from rounding:list; no control deletes all patients at once

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Hospital only, and they pass with the browser's native confirm, so they say nothing about AC 7's app-style pop-up or AC 8's toast (S16/S17), and 'removed from rounding:list' would also pass a soft delete (S20). 'Once' holds because a second dialog would be auto-dismissed and the OK test would fail

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S18

Existing specs: delete asks once, Cancel keeps, OK removes, and there is no bulk delete

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — asks first, and the patient survives a cancel — expected
  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — confirming removal deletes the patient and closes the loop — expected
  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — offers no way to delete every patient at once — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec): its fixtures are fresh @roundai.test accounts made with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
